程序包 org.bukkit.event.player

类 PlayerCommandPreprocessEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerEvent
org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerCommandPreprocessEvent
所有已实现的接口:
Cancellable
public class PlayerCommandPreprocessEvent extends PlayerEvent implements Cancellable
This event is called whenever a player runs a command (by placing a slash at the start of their message). It is called early in the command handling process, and modifications in this event (via setMessage(String)) will be shown in the behavior. 当玩家运行命令时（在消息开头加上斜杠）调用此事件。它在命令处理流程的早期被调用，在此事件中所做的修改（通过 setMessage(String)）将反映到后续行为中。

Many plugins will have no use for this event, and you should attempt to avoid using it if it is not necessary. 许多插件用不到此事件，如非必要，应尽量避免使用它。

Some examples of valid uses for this event are: 此事件的一些合理用途示例：

  • Logging executed commands to a separate file 将执行的命令记录到单独的文件
  • Variable substitution. For example, replacing ${nearbyPlayer} with the name of the nearest other player, or simulating the @a and @p decorators used by Command Blocks in plugins that do not handle it. 变量替换。例如将 ${nearbyPlayer} 替换为最近的其他玩家的名字，或在不处理这些标记的插件中模拟命令方块使用的 @a 与 @p 选择器。
  • Conditionally blocking commands belonging to other plugins. For example, blocking the use of the /home command in a combat arena. 有条件地拦截属于其他插件的命令。例如，在战斗竞技场中禁止使用 /home 命令。
  • Per-sender command aliases. For example, after a player runs the command /calias cr gamemode creative, the next time they run /cr, it gets replaced into /gamemode creative. (Global command aliases should be done by registering the alias.) 按发送者区分的命令别名。例如，玩家运行命令 /calias cr gamemode creative 后，下次运行 /cr 时会被替换为 /gamemode creative。（全局命令别名应通过注册别名来实现。）

Examples of incorrect uses are: 不正确用途的示例：

  • Using this event to run command logic 使用此事件来运行命令逻辑

If the event is cancelled, processing of the command will halt. 如果该事件被取消，命令的处理将中止。

The state of whether or not there is a slash (/) at the beginning of the message should be preserved. If a slash is added or removed, unexpected behavior may result. 消息开头是否有斜杠（/）的状态应当保留。如果添加或删除斜杠，可能导致意外行为。

    • getRecipients

      @Deprecated public Set<Player> getRecipients()
      已过时。
      This method is provided for backward compatibility with no guarantee to the effect of viewing or modifying the set. 此方法仅为向后兼容而保留，不保证查看或修改该集合会产生效果。
      Gets a set of recipients that this chat message will be displayed to. 获取将向其显示此聊天消息的接收者集合。

      The set returned is not guaranteed to be mutable and may auto-populate on access. Any listener accessing the returned set should be aware that it may reduce performance for a lazy set implementation. Listeners should be aware that modifying the list may throw UnsupportedOperationException if the event caller provides an unmodifiable set. 返回的集合不保证可变，且可能在访问时自动填充。任何访问返回集合的监听器都应注意，对于惰性集合实现，这可能降低性能。监听器应注意，如果事件调用者提供的是不可修改的集合，修改该列表可能抛出 UnsupportedOperationException。

      返回:
      All Players who will see this chat message 将看到此聊天消息的所有玩家
